resources.string: Take full control of the 8-LED rear array on your Pixel 11 Pro.
HiLight Plus replaces standard stock lighting with customizable patterns, contact caller alerts, and AI visual states—all running seamlessly without root.
HiLight Plus connects to Shizuku to communicate with the hardware lights service.
Both Favorite calls and Gemini feedback lighting are turned on in system settings (Settings → System → HiLight). Please turn them off to prevent lighting conflicts.
Favorite calls lighting is turned on in system settings (Settings → System → HiLight). Please turn it off to allow HiLight Plus to control call alerts.
Gemini feedback lighting is turned on in system settings (Settings → System → HiLight). Please turn it off to allow HiLight Plus to control assistant lighting.
Pick a color below and tap Test to light the 8-LED array for 3 seconds.
